gloss: at once, in one go, all at once

definitions.gloss: at once, in one go, all at once
definitions.explanation: Doing or achieving something all at one time, in a single action or effort, rather than gradually.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I solved the problems all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{変換|へんかん}できる→変換する：09890_henkansuru⟧。
examples.english: With this app, you can convert multiple files all at once.

notes:
USAGE: Emphasizes doing something in a single stroke or burst rather than in stages. It often appears in formal writing and news reporting but is also used in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧: to resolve all at once
- {一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to deal with everything in one go
- {一挙|いっきょ}に⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance all at once

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in one breath, in one go (more colloquial)
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: all at one time
- {一挙両得|いっきょりょうとく}: killing two birds with one stone (yojijukugo)
